title: Here's what I've made with 2 Months of Claude - Asteroid Defense
author: StellarSoupStudio
selftext:
Link to game: [https://ad.stellarsoup.com](https://ad.stellarsoup.com)

Hi all, finally ready to get some feedback on my personal project. I have larger plans for this game but right now I'm looking for feedback on difficulty and intuitiveness.

Its inspired by a lot of games but the core loop is the of the orbital mechanics of Kerbal Space Program mixed with Asteroids and Missile Command. I really liked the design philosophy of Shovel Knight in that it took modern game design and applied it to an old genre, so I went and added real physics to the space games of the arcade era.

Works best with a controller btw, but is very playable with mouse and keyboard.
